subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about the complex mini golf project you will create in this level!

questions.hint: Did you select the best possible use of a status bar in this game?
questions.title: [Select one] How might a status bar be used in this Mini Golf project?

answers.text: To show the player’s progress through the golf course.
To show the hole’s par score and how the player’s score compares.
To show the amount of force the player is going to hit the ball with.
To show how much energy the player has before they’re too tired to continue the game.

questions.correctResponse: Using the status bar to cycle through its lowest to highest values allows the player to select how much force they want to hit the ball with. This allows for a better, more controlled user experience.

questions.hint: The timer.after function can only affect code called inside of the function.
questions.title: [Select one] The timer.after function runs its attached code after a certain amount of time. This might be helpful when…

answers.text: Allowing for effects, animations or collisions between sprites to show before the ensuing code is run.
Stopping all code from running for a set amount of time.

questions.correctResponse: The timer.after function may be helpful for showing effects, animations or collisions before sprites are destroyed or tilemaps are changed.

questions.hint: What kind of information is needed when playing a game of (mini) golf?
questions.title: [Select multiple] What kind of UI elements might be needed in the mini golf game?

answers.text: The current hole number on the golf course.
How much force the Player can hit the ball with.
A score card with the player’s game summary.

questions.correctResponse: Additional UI elements, such as instructions and game screens can also be included!

attributes.description: Welcome to Level 1 of Red Belt! In this level, you’ll apply your previous learning by creating a complex mini golf project in JavaScript across 3 different Build activities. There is no pre-assessment Quest activity for this level, so click “Start Level” to begin! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 1:
